nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set of source symbols, let $\beta$ be a finite alphabet with $D \ge 2$ letters, and let $l : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$. There is a prefix-free code assigning to each $a \in \alpha$ a word over $\beta$ of length $l(a)$ if and only if $\sum_{a \in \alpha} D^{-l(a)} \le 1$.
nodes.title: Kraft's inequality for prefix codes
